Private Sub Act(ByVal which As Long, ByVal ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, st As Object, o As Object, s2 As Variant, failure As Long)
    Dim v2 As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB = 65280: sh.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1: Set st = sh.Fill.GradientStops
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        s2 = st.Count
    Case 1
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5
    Case 2
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, 0.5
    Case 3
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , 1
    Case 4
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , 3
    Case 5
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , 2
    Case 6
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , 4
    Case 7
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , 0
    Case 8
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4
    Case 9
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , -0.4
    Case 10
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0
    Case 11
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 1
    Case 12
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , -1
    Case 13
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 2
    Case 14
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, 0.5, 2, 0.4
    Case 15
        st.Insert2 16711680, 2
    Case 16
        st.Insert2 16711680, -1
    Case 17
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, 2
    Case 18
        st.Insert2 16711680
    Case 19
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0
    Case 20
        st.Insert2 16711680, 1
    Case 21
        st.Insert2 RGB:=16711680, Position:=0.5, Brightness:=0.4
    Case 22
        st.Insert 16711680, 0.5: st.Insert2 255, 0.25, , , 0.4
    Case 23
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: st.Insert 255, 0.25
    Case 24
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: s2 = st(3).Color.Brightness & "|" & st(3).Color.RGB & "|" & st(3).Color.Type & "|" & st(3).Color.TintAndShade
    Case 25
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: st.Delete 3
    Case 26
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: st(3).Position = 0.75
    Case 27
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: st(3).Color.RGB = 255
    Case 28
        st.Insert2 16711680, 0.5, , , 0.4: st(3).Transparency = 0.5
    Case 29
        For Each o In st: s2 = s2 & o.Position & "/" & o.Color.RGB & ",": Next
    Case 30
        For Each o In st: o.Transparency = 0.5: Next
    Case 31
        st.Insert 16711680, 0.5: For Each o In st: s2 = s2 & TypeName(o) & o.Position & ",": Next
    Case 32
        s2 = TypeName(st.Application) & "|" & st.Application.Name
    Case 33
        s2 = st.Creator
    Case 34
        s2 = TypeName(st(1).Application) & "|" & st(1).Application.Name
    Case 35
        s2 = st(1).Creator
    Case 36
        s2 = TypeName(st)
    Case 37
        Set o = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 1, 1, 5, 5).Fill.GradientStops: s2 = TypeName(o.Application)
    Case 38
        Set o = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 1, 1, 5, 5).Fill.GradientStops: s2 = o.Creator
    Case 39
        Set o = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 1, 1, 5, 5).Fill.GradientStops: For Each v2 In o: s2 = "x": Next
    Case 40
        Set o = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 1, 1, 5, 5).Fill.GradientStops: o.Insert2 255, 0.5
    End Select
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    failure = Err.Number
End Sub

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, st As Object, o As Object, s As String, v As String, s2 As Variant, failure As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Act which, ws, sh, st, o, s2, failure
    s = IIf(failure = 0, "ok", "Err " & failure)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(1).Position
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(1).Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(1).Color.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(1).Color.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(2).Position
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(2).Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(2).Color.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(2).Color.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(3).Position
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(3).Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(3).Color.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(3).Color.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(4).Position
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(4).Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(4).Color.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = st(4).Color.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = s2
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 40
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
